spans.s: न-असत्य m. du. Aśvins, the twin physicians of the gods.

नश् vt. 4P (pp. नष्ट; pres. नश्यति, प्रणश्यति; caus. नाशयति; desid. निनङ्क्षति, निनशिषति) 1. To be lost, to disappear, to become invisible, to vanish, विद्युद्भिः क्षणनष्टदृष्टतिमिरं प्रच्छादिताशामुखम् Mrich.v.; 2. to be destroyed, to perish, M.viii.247, Bg.xviii.73; 3. to become unsuccessful; 4. to run away, to escape, नेशुश्चित्रा निशाचराः Bt.xiv.112; (the root is often used with the prepositions प्र and वि, without any change in meaning).
नश् f. Destruction, perishing, disappearing.
नस् f. The nose.(This word has no forms for the first five cases; some think that it is not a separate word but an optional substitute for नासिका in all cases except the first five.)
नश m. Destruction, perishing, disappearing.
नसा f. The nose.
नाश m. 1. Disappearance, frustration, destruction, ruin, Bg.ii.40, R.viii.88, M.viii.17; 2. death; 3. misfortune; 4. abandonment, desertion; 5. flight, retreat.
नासा f. 1. The nose, नासाभ्येति तिलप्रासूनपदवीम् Git.G.x., Bg.v.26; 2. the trunk of an elephant; 3. the upper timber of a door-frame.
नशन n. Destruction, perishing, disappearing.
नाशन n. 1. Death, destruction, ruin; 2. removal, expulsion.
नश्वर a. (f. री) 1. Perishable, transitory evanescent, निखिलं जगदेव नश्वरम् Bh.V.iv.24; 2. destructive, mischievous.
नश्वर a. (f. री) 1. Perishable, transitory evanescent, निखिलं जगदेव नश्वरम् Bh.V.iv.24; 2. destructive, mischievous.
नष्ट a. (f. ष्टा) 1. Lost, disappeared, vanished; 2. perished, destroyed; 3. run away, escaped; 4. deprived of, (pp. of नश् q.v.).
नष्ट a. (f. ष्टा) 1. Lost, disappeared, vanished; 2. perished, destroyed; 3. run away, escaped; 4. deprived of, (pp. of नश् q.v.).
नष्ट-अर्थ a. reduced to poverty.
नष्ट-आतंकम् ind. without anxiety or fear, नष्टातंकं हरिणशिशवो मंदमंदं चरंति Sak.i.
नष्ट-आत्मन् a. deprived of sense.
नष्ट-आप्तिसूत्र n. booty, plunder.
नष्ट-आशंक a. fearless.
नष्ट-इंदुकला f. the day of new moon.
नष्ट-इंद्रिय a. deprived of senses.
नष्ट-चेतन, -चेष्ट, -संज्ञ a. unconscious, insensible, fainted.
नष्ट-चेतन, -चेष्ट, -संज्ञ a. unconscious, insensible, fainted.
नष्ट-चेतन, -चेष्ट, -संज्ञ a. unconscious, insensible, fainted.
नष्ट-चेष्टता f. universal destruction.
नस्तस् ind. from the nose, Yaj.iii.127.
नस्त (I) m. The nose.
नस्त (II) n. A sternutatory.
नस्ता f. A hole bored in the septum of the nose.
नस्ता-ऊत m. an ox led by a string through the nose.
नस्तित a. (f. ता) Nozzled.
नस्तित a. (f. ता) Nozzled.
नस्य n. 1. The hairs in the nose; 2. a sternutatory.
नस्या f. 1. The nose; 2. the string through the nose of an animal.
नास्य n. A nose cord.
नाशिन् a. (f. नी) 1. Destructive; 2. perishing, perishable, Bg.ii.18.
नाशिन् a. (f. नी) 1. Destructive; 2. perishing, perishable, Bg.ii.18.
नाष्टिक m. The owner of anything lost.
नासा-अग्र n. the tip of the nose.
नासा-च्छिद्र, -रंध्र, -विवर n. nostril.
नासा-च्छिद्र, -रंध्र, -विवर n. nostril.
नासा-च्छिद्र, -रंध्र, -विवर n. nostril.
नासा-दारु n. the upper timber of a door-frame.
नासा-परिस्राव m. a running the nose, a running cold.
नासा-पुट m.n. a nostril.
नासा-वंश m. the bridge of the nose.
नासिका f. The same as नासा q.v., M.ii.90, Bg.vi.13.
नासिकंधम a. blowing through the nose, snoring.
नासिकंधय a. drinking through the nose.
नासिका-मल m. the mucus of the nose.
नासिक्य (I) a. (f. क्या) Nasal.
नासिक्य (II) m. A nasal sound.
नासिक्य (III) n. The nose.
नासिक्य (I) a. (f. क्या) Nasal.
नासीर (I) n. Advancing in front of an army.
नासीर (II) m. A champion who advances before the line.
नास्ति ind. Non-existence, e.g. नास्तिक्षार.
नास्ति-वाद m. assertion of the nonexistence of God, infidelity, atheism, बौद्धेनेव सर्वदानास्तिवादशूरेण Kad.
नास्तिक m. One who denies the divine authority of the Vedas, or a future life, or the existence of a ruler or creator of the universe, M.ii.11.
नास्तिक्य n. Infidelity, atheism, heresy.
नास्तिद m. The mango tree.
